conflict: During a halt in the ash wastes of Mordor, Samwise Gamgee notices Frodo Baggins is barely able to stand under the weight of the One Ring and offers to carry it for a while to give him rest. Frodo violently refuses, convinced Sam is trying to steal the Ring for himself.

relationships.description: Lifelong friends and fellow travelers; Sam's devotion is tested by the Ring's growing paranoia inside Frodo's mind.
